gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histological, cytological, or molecular confirmation of recurrent GBM or other glioma, circumscribed astrocytic glioma, or glioneuronalor neuronal tumors that has recurred.

candidate_evidence.quote: This is an open-label, monotherapy study of pemigatinib in participants with recurrent glioblastoma (GBM) or other recurrent gliomas

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: MRI-documented objective progression after prior therapy and must have no therapy available that is likely to provide clinical benefit.

role_evidence.quote: Pemigatinib (other names: NCB054828): 13.5mg tablet taken every morning (unless otherwise directed) for 2 weeks and then 1 week off.

arms: Cohort B: Other gliomas other than GBM

source_quote.quote: Documentation of an actionable FGFR1-3 gene mutation or fusion/rearrangement from tissue
Participants with histopathologically proven, WHO Grade 4, IDH-wild-type GBM OR molecular diagnosis of IDH-wild-type, diffuse astrocytic glioma with molecular features of Grade 4 GBM

coder_notes: Two cohorts: A recurrent IDH-wildtype GBM, B other gliomas/glioneuronal tumours; all require activating FGFR1-3 alteration (candidate-matched with pemigatinib, an FGFR inhibitor per drug knowledge; mechanism not explicitly stated in record). IDH-wildtype used only to define the GBM cohort. cns5 from IDH-wild-type requirement for GBM.
